title.description: The title a group room was created with.

mediaType.description: The media type the blob was stored with.

name.description: The new entry's name, the name its blob was stored under.

onConflict.description: What to do when `name` is taken; `refuse` when absent.

requestId.description: Chosen by the sender; the event's own key when there is none.

size.description: The size of the file, in bytes.

id.description: The blob's id: `fid1:` and the hash of its name, media type and bytes.

space.description: The DID of the space whose blob store holds the bytes.

chatRoom.description: The declared conversation, wherever its room lives.

fileStoreRecord.description: Where the container keeps its space's file store.

counterpart.description: A direct room's other member, by principal.

kind.description: The room's kind, as its `about.kind` says.

revision.description:
The opaque revision supplied by `rooms` for its membership or discovery
source. A request to forget uses that view's revision; direct mappings
and act outcomes may omit it.

since.description: When first listed for this user, using catalog admission for discovery.

id.description: The notice's id, unique in the manager.

recipient.description: The DID of the person admitted.

room.description: The room the recipient was admitted to.

avatar.description: The person's avatar: a URL or a glyph, if they have set one.

inbox.description:
Where the person's offers are delivered, as the profile types its pointer:
a link naming nothing of the inbox but its name. An inbox labels its
offers confidential to its owner, and a run reading the pointer as a link
to more of the inbox, or untyped, takes that label on, which then refuses
its sends.

name.description: The person's display name, if they have set one.

delivery.description: How `offerRoom` told the member of the room; absent for the others.

entry.description: The entry it produced; absent for `forget` and `offerRoom`.

code.description:
Which refusal it is, for a client to act on, where a client has one to
take; absent for the others.

reason.description: Why, for a person to read.

createdAt.description: When the room was created; absent for a space's own chat.

kind.description: `"direct"` if created as a direct room; `"group"` otherwise.

policy.description: The room's policy, stated correctly, in a document of its own.

record.description:
The record the room's creator wrote, whose label names them; absent for a
space's own chat, which no one created as a room.

title.description:
The room's title, which every member shares: the one a member last set,
or else the one the room was created with. A direct room has none until a
member sets one, and a space's own chat has none.

about.description: What the room says about itself.

messages.description: Where the conversation stands: what of `messages` every member shares.

count.description: How many messages the room holds, obliterated tombstones included.

newestAt.description: The newest message's `sentAt`; absent while there are none.

roster.description:
The profiles of those who joined the room, in the order they joined, as a
manager reads them: each a link, whose profile is read only through it.

deletionIsObliteration.description: Whether a sender's deletion of their own message obliterates it.

keepsHistory.description: Stated for the policy's shape, and read by nothing: a message keeps no history.

maxOpenWindows.description: Stated for the policy's shape, and read by nothing: the room offers no windows.

maxWindowCount.description: How many of the newest messages `messages.latest` holds.

ownersMayObliterate.description: Whether an OWNER may obliterate messages.

proposedTimeMaxAgeNsec.description: Stated for the policy's shape, and read by nothing: a sender proposes no time.

proposedTimeMaxLeadNsec.description: Stated for the policy's shape, and read by nothing: a sender proposes no time.

recentActivityWindowNsec.description: Stated for the policy's shape, and read by nothing: the room keeps no activity log.

adopt.description:
The inbox the deciding profile advertises, which the host has vetted for
Home to adopt; absent when the host vetted none.

from.description:
The deciding profile: the first, in the order `#profile` answers in, that
points at an inbox. Absent from a host that names none, which Home takes
as the first profile in its list that points at an inbox.

refused.description:
The host's refusal of the inbox the deciding profile advertises, for Home
to record; absent when the host refused none.

reason.description: Why the host refused it, by its code.

$NAME.description: The manager's name, for lists of pieces.

$VIEWS.description: The manager's data face, as one group.

accept.description: Records a room this user has been admitted to.

direct.description: The direct room this user shares with each counterpart, by principal.

forget.description: Removes a room from this user's list.

joinRoom.description:
Makes a room this user has entered one of their chats: lists it, or
lists it again once forgotten, and adds them to its participants. A room
their chats list already is left as it is.

offerRoom.description:
Offers someone added to a room the room, where this user may add people
to it, and records how they were told of it.

openDirect.description: Finds or creates the direct room with a person.

outgoingNotices.description:
Notices this user's requests have produced that no one has delivered,
other than those whose room's roster lists a profile attesting their
recipient.

people.description:
The people this user's rooms list, other than this user: by the principal
each one's profile attests, the profiles attesting it, each once, in the
order the rooms, newest first, list them.

requests.description: The outcome of each request, by the `requestId` its caller chose.

roomMembership.description: Explicit room membership, including forgotten conversations.

rooms.description: Every room this user belongs to and hasn't forgotten, newest first.

roomMembership.description: Explicit room membership, including forgotten conversations.

addedBy.description: The profile of whoever added it.

mediaType.description: The media type of the bytes.

name.description: The name the store finds this file by, and its blob's name.

removedAt.description: When the file was removed from its store, if it has been.

size.description: The size of the file, in bytes.

name.description: The name the person goes by.

entry.description: The entry the request added or changed.

name.description: The name the request gave the entry.

code.description: Why, as a code a client can act on.

reason.description: Why, as prose for a person.

add.description: Adds a file, for a blob already in the store's space.

entries.description: Every file in the store, in the order they were added.

remove.description: Takes a file out of the store, and marks it removed.

rename.description: Changes a file's name, and its blob with it.

requests.description: The outcome of each request, by its `requestId`.

add.description: Adds a file, for a blob already in the store's space.

entries.description: Every file in the store, in the order they were added.

remove.description: Takes a file out of the store, and marks it removed.

rename.description: Changes a file's name, and its blob with it.

requests.description: The outcome of each request, by its `requestId`.

store.description: The store; absent while the root names none.

container.description: The container whose explicit `chatRoom` declaration names the room.

counterpart.description: The DID of a direct room's other member.

id.description: The id of a notice delivered.

joinableByLink.description:
Whether a new group room admits anyone who has its link; absent for a room
admitting its members alone.

keepArchived.description:
Whether accepting a room leaves its entry archived, when it is; absent,
accepting the room restores it.

member.description: The DID of a member added to a room, whom `offerRoom` offers it to.

members.description: The DIDs of a new group room's other members.

messageAct.description:
Whether a `joinRoom` comes from a message or a reaction the user sent in
the room, which leaves the title the catalog lists an already listed room
under as it is.

profile.description:
A direct room's other member's profile, through whose share inbox a new
room, or a found one that was offered them nothing, is offered to them, or
the profile of a member added to a room, through whose share inbox
`offerRoom` offers it.

profiles.description:
The profiles of more of a new group room's other members, each naming its
member with its `represents-principal` label, through whose share inbox
the room is offered to them.

requestId.description:
Chosen by the sender; the outcome is recorded under it, except for a start
that would create a room without its reviewed `ChatStart`, which is
refused whole and records none.

revision.description:
The revision of a room's entry, as the list the request was made from
showed it, for a room to forget.

room.description: A room to offer, accept, join, or forget.

target.description: A rendered control's text, or the profile it starts a direct room with.

dataset.description: The principal an older room's chip names the person by.

name.description: The profile of the person a participant's chip starts a chat with.

inbox.description: The inbox refused, which the deciding profile points at.

reason.description:
The host's code for why it refused the inbox, as the event named it,
trimmed and cut to `REFUSAL_REASON_MAX_LENGTH`. Today the host sends one
of `InboxAdoptionRefusal`'s codes, from
`packages/piece/src/ops/private-inbox.ts`, such as
`inbox-adoption-acl-mismatch`.

refusedAt.description:
When Home first recorded this refusal, of this inbox for this reason, in
milliseconds since the epoch. A handler's clock reads to the second.

inbox.description: The refused inbox, which the profiles pointing at it no longer advertise.

reason.description: The host's code for why it refused that inbox, as the refusal held it.

refusedAt.description: When Home first recorded the refusal, as the refusal held it.

replacedAt.description:
When the owner had Home replace the inbox, in milliseconds since the epoch.
A handler's clock reads to the second.

from.description:
The profile the client finds the owner by, which is to advertise Home's
inbox: the one `#profile` answers with.

requestId.description: Chosen by the sender; the event's own key when there is none.

onConflict.description: What to do when `name` is taken; `refuse` when absent.

requestId.description: Chosen by the sender; the event's own key when there is none.

catalogRevision.description: A standalone catalog revision, which keeps the catalog authoritative.

container.description: The root declaring a conversation joined through a container.

counterpart.description: A direct room's other member, by principal.

kind.description: The room's kind, as its `about.kind` says.

revision.description: The event that last changed membership.

since.description: When first listed for this user, using catalog admission for discovery.

state.description: Whether the user keeps the conversation in their chats.

inbox.description: The inbox piece to point at; absent clears the pointer.

replacing.description:
What the profile is to point at for the write to happen. Left out, the
pointer is set whatever it holds. Present and `undefined`, it is set only
while the profile points at no inbox. A link, it is set only while the
profile points at that inbox, by a comparison of links that reads only
link shape: a link to an inbox holding nothing is a link, and names it.
An event spelled `{ inbox, replacing: undefined }` is a conditional one.

socialSpaceCollection.description: The collection browser's named instance and session-local controls.
